mostWorthwhile.text: Renewing the bone patch was most worthwhile: clearing it and then filling it made the idea that bone changes over time easy to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Bringing skin and blood renewal together felt less interesting because it mostly combined two processes already shown.

surprise.text: I was surprised that a small patch of bone is removed and replaced while the rest of the skeleton stays in place.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though after the first choice I followed the only offered combinations rather than figuring out which pairs worked myself.

continue.text: I would consider continuing to see another connection between body systems, though the mostly single-option sequence made the gameplay feel a bit repetitive.
